crossrefs.text: the One who does great and unsearchable things, wonders without number.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
I am pleased to declare the signs and wonders that the Most High God has performed for me.
How great are His signs, how mighty His wonders! His kingdom is an eternal kingdom; His dominion endures from generation to generation.
Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
Does it please You to oppress me, to reject the work of Your hands and favor the schemes of the wicked?
If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.
By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
Will You never look away from me, or leave me alone to swallow my spittle?
But if you would earnestly seek God and ask the Almighty for mercy,
He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.
Egyptʼs help is futile and empty; therefore I have called her Rahab Who Sits Still.
Although you wash with lye and use an abundance of soap, the stain of your guilt is still before Me,” declares the Lord GOD.

If a man sins against another man, God can intercede for him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who can intercede for him?” But they would not listen to their father, since the LORD intended to put them to death.
Whatever exists was named long ago, and it is know what man is; but he cannot contend with one stronger than he.
Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
If it is a matter of strength, He is indeed mighty! If it is a matter of justice, who can summon Him?
